# Script API

<!-- Generated by tools/script_api/gen.mjs from tools/script_api/api.mjs. Don't edit. -->

Scripts are Lua 5.4, one per entity (the Script component). These are the callbacks the engine calls, the built-in tables, and the named helpers. An autocomplete stub for LuaLS is in [scripting/engine_api.lua](scripting/engine_api.lua); the editor's Script card has the same list under **API**.

## Callbacks and timers

| Function | When |
|---|---|
| `on_start()` | Once, when play starts. |
| `on_tick(dt: number)` | Every tick (1/60 s). |
| `on_ui(name: string, value: any)` | A UI element was used, or the host sent an event. |
| `on_message(name: string, value: any, sender: integer)` | Another script called world.send. |
| `on_damaged(amount: number, attacker: integer?)` | This entity was hurt. |
| `on_death(attacker: integer?)` | Health reached 0. |
| `on_kill(victim: integer)` | This entity defeated another. |
| `on_melee_hit(target: integer, move: string, damage: number, outcome: string)` | This fighter's blow met someone: hit, blocked, parried, dodged or guard_break. |
| `on_collision_enter(other: integer)` | Started touching (also _stay, _exit). |
| `on_trigger_enter(other: integer)` | Something entered this trigger (also _stay, _exit). |
| `on_anim_state(state: string)` | The Animator entered a state. |
| `on_anim_event(name: string)` | An Animator event fired. |
| `after(seconds: number, fn: function): integer` | Calls fn once later; cancel(handle) stops it. |
| `every(seconds: number, fn: function): integer` | Calls fn repeatedly. |
| `start(fn: function)` | Runs fn as a coroutine that can wait(seconds). |

## world

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `world.find(name: string): integer?` | The id of the first entity with this name. |
| `world.name(id: integer): string?` | An entity's name. |
| `world.alive(id: integer): boolean` | False once the entity is destroyed. |
| `world.position(id: integer): number?, number?, number?` | Where the entity is. |
| `world.set_position(id: integer, x: number, y: number, z: number)` | Moves the entity. |
| `world.velocity(id: integer): number?, number?, number?` | Its velocity (m/s). |
| `world.set_velocity(id: integer, x: number, y: number, z: number)` | Sets its velocity. |
| `world.spawn(prefab: string, x: number, y: number, z: number): integer?` | A new instance of a prefab; returns its id. |
| `world.destroy(id: integer)` | Removes the entity. |
| `world.health(id: integer): number?, number?` | Current and maximum health. |
| `world.damage(id: integer, amount: number)` | Hurts the entity (on_damaged, then on_death at 0). |
| `world.heal(id: integer, amount: number)` | Restores health up to its maximum. |
| `world.give_ammo(id: integer, rounds: integer, slot?: integer)` | Adds reserve rounds to its weapon. |
| `world.raycast(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, max: number, mask?: integer): table?` | The first hit along a ray: {id, x, y, z, nx, ny, nz, distance}. |
| `world.overlap(x, y, z, radius: number, mask?: integer): integer[]` | Entities with colliders inside a sphere. |
| `world.send(id: integer, name: string, value?: any)` | Calls the entity's on_message(name, value, sender). |
| `world.path(x, y, z, tx, ty, tz: number): table[]?` | Waypoints {x, y, z} around obstacles, or nil when unreachable. |
| `world.set_clock(hours: number): number` | The scene clock that Routines follow. |
| `world.wildlife_state(name: string)` | 0 calm, 1 wary, 2 fleeing, -1 not an animal. |

## host

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `host.send(kind: string, text: string)` | A raw message to the host (the named helpers below send these for you). |

## physics

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `physics.add_force(id: integer, x: number, y: number, z: number)` | A force for this tick. |
| `physics.add_impulse(id: integer, x: number, y: number, z: number)` | An instant change of momentum. |

## sound

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `sound.play(name: string)` | Plays a sound from the catalog. |
| `sound.play_at(name: string, x: number, y: number, z: number, volume?: number)` | Plays a sound in the world. |
| `sound.volume(bus: string, level: number)` | Sets a mixer bus volume 0-1 (master, sfx, music, ambient, ui). |

## ui

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `ui.set_text(name: string, text: string)` | Changes a UI element's text. |
| `ui.set_value(name: string, value: number)` | Sets a Bar, Slider or Toggle (0-1). |
| `ui.set_visible(name: string, visible: boolean)` | Shows or hides a UI element. |
| `ui.marker(name: string, x: number, y: number, z: number, label?: string)` | An on-screen waypoint at a world position, pinned to the screen edge when off screen. |
| `ui.clear_marker(id: string)` | Removes a marker. |

## game

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `game.pause()` | Pauses play. |
| `game.resume()` | Resumes play. |

## anim

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `anim.set(name: string, value: any)` | Sets an Animator parameter. |

## camera

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `camera.shake(intensity?: number, seconds?: number)` | Shakes the game camera (defaults 0.3, 0.4 s). |

## vehicle

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `vehicle.state(id: integer): number, number, integer, number, number, boolean, boolean, number, number` | speed, forward, gear, rpm, nitro, drifting, boosting, yaw, slip. |
| `vehicle.set_nitro(id: integer, amount: number)` | Refills the nitro tank. |
| `vehicle.reset(id: integer, x: number, y: number, z: number, yaw: number)` | Puts the car back on its wheels at a place. |
| `vehicle.freeze(id: integer, frozen: boolean)` | Holds the car in place (countdowns). |
| `vehicle.set_route(id: integer, route: string, loop?: boolean)` | An AI driver's route: 'x,z x,z ...'. |
| `vehicle.set_target(id: integer, target: integer)` | Who an AI driver pursues. |
| `vehicle.set_mode(id: integer, mode: string)` | Race, Pursuit, Traffic or Off. |
| `vehicle.set_speed_scale(id: integer, scale: number)` | Slows or speeds an AI driver. |

## space

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `space.state(): table?` | The ship and frame: altitude, speed, fuel, hull, landed, frame, site, ... |
| `space.events(): string[]` | touchdown, liftoff, soi:<body>, frame:<body>, site:<name>, reframe, ... since the last call. |
| `space.set_warp(factor: number)` | Time warp. |
| `space.set_assist(mode: string)` | manual, stabilized, prograde, retrograde or target. |
| `space.set_target(body: string)` | The navigation target. |
| `space.refuel(amount: number)` | Adds fuel. |
| `space.set_fuel(amount: number)` | Sets the fuel. |
| `space.tune(field: string, value: number)` | Changes a ship spec value (upgrades). |
| `space.spec(): table` | {thrust, lift, fuel, hull, heat, rcs} |
| `space.repair(amount: number)` | Repairs the hull. |
| `space.board()` | Puts the walker in the ship. |
| `space.exit()` | Steps out of the ship. |
| `space.set_controls(enabled: boolean)` | Lets the player fly (off for menus and cut-scenes). |
| `space.place_landed(body: string, latitude: number, longitude: number, heading?: number)` | Sets the ship down at a place. |
| `space.place_orbit(body: string, altitude: number)` | Puts the ship in a circular orbit. |
| `space.body(name: string): table?` | {radius, gravity, atmosphere, distance, altitude} |
| `space.call(op: string, text?: string, ...: number): table?` | The generic call the named helpers use. |
| `space.set_hull(value: number)` | Sets the hull exactly (loading a save). |
| `space.set_time(seconds: number)` | Sets the system clock: where every planet is. |
| `space.settle()` | Puts everyone with a Routine at the stop the clock says. |
| `space.reveal(body: string)` | Shows a hidden body. |
| `space.bodies()` | Every visible body, one per line: name and parent. |
| `space.plan(body: string)` | A route plan to a body: distance, delta-v and the fuel it needs. |
| `space.autopilot(on: boolean)` | Engages or releases the autopilot toward the target. |
| `space.use_reserve()` | Releases the emergency fuel reserve (once, below 35%). |
| `space.repair_part(part: string, amount: number)` | Repairs (+) or damages (-) engine, rcs, gear or scanner; returns its condition. |
| `space.set_wind(x: number, y: number, z: number)` | Wind on the ship and walker (m/s, site frame). |
| `space.allow_boarding(allowed: boolean)` | Whether E boards the ship. |

| Function | What it does |

| `particles.set_emitting(on: boolean)` | Starts or stops this entity's emitter. |

## melee

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `melee.perform(move: string): boolean` | Starts a move of this fighter's Melee list by name (when it can act). |
| `melee.state(): string, integer, number, number, number` | Mode (idle, move, block, stun, airborne, down, getup, dead), combo, energy, energy max, guard 0-1. |
| `melee.move(): string` | The move playing, or "". |
| `melee.set_energy(amount: number)` | Sets its energy (specials spend it). |
| `melee.lock(id?: integer)` | Locks onto a target; no argument releases. |
| `melee.target(): integer?` | Who it faces and fights. |
| `melee.set_ai(on: boolean, aggression?: number, skill?: number)` | Hands the fighter to (or takes it from) its melee brain. |
| `melee.unlock(move: string): number?` | Makes a move marked locked usable; 1 when the move exists. |
| `melee.stagger(): number, number` | Its poise bar 0-1, and 1 while it's Broken. |
| `melee.tune(damage: number, speed: number, crit: number, skill: number, health_max?: number, mana_max?: number): number, number, number, number` | Stats: damage dealt (times), its clock speed (0.5-2: attacks, dodges, cooldowns), crit chance 0-1 (1.5x), skill damage (times, moves that cost mana), and optionally max health and mana. -1 keeps one as is. |

## input

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `input.down(key: string): boolean` | A key held this tick, by its code (KeyW, Space, Enter) or its lowercase name (w, enter). |
| `input.pressed(key: string): boolean` | A key pressed this tick. |
| `input.action(name: string): number` | An action's value (axes -1..1, buttons 0/1). |
| `input.action_down(name: string): boolean` | An action held. |
| `input.action_pressed(name: string): boolean` | An action pressed this tick. |
| `input.action_released(name: string): boolean` | An action released this tick. |
| `input.mouse(): number, number` | The mouse position in the viewport. |
| `input.mouse_down(button: integer): boolean` | A mouse button held. |
| `input.mouse_pressed(button: integer): boolean` | A mouse button pressed this tick. |
| `input.wheel(): number` | Scroll this tick. |
| `input.pad_down(button: string): boolean` | A gamepad button held. |
| `input.pad_pressed(button: string): boolean` | A gamepad button pressed this tick. |
| `input.pad_axis(axis: string): number` | A gamepad stick axis. |
| `input.pad_connected(): boolean` | A gamepad is connected. |
| `input.lock_mouse(locked: boolean)` | Captures the mouse for looking around. |

| Function | What it does |

## hud

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `hud.announce(text: string)` | Reads a line aloud for screen readers and shows it briefly. |
| `hud.cue(name: string)` | Plays an interface sound cue. |
| `hud.waypoint(id: string, body: string, latitude: number, longitude: number, label: string)` | A waypoint at a place on a planet. |
| `hud.clear_waypoint(id: string)` | Removes a waypoint. |
| `hud.map(mode: string)` | off, system, surface or toggle. |
| `hud.minimap(shown: boolean)` | Shows or hides the minimap. |
| `hud.open_settings()` | Opens the player settings panel. |
| `hud.visor(helmet: boolean, integrity: number, frost: number, heat: number)` | The helmet visor: on or off, integrity 0-1 (cracks below), frost and heat shimmer 0-1. |
| `hud.suit_light(mode: string)` | auto, on or off. |
| `hud.system(title: string, body: string)` | Shows a Ledger system window (title, body lines split by \n); replaces the open one. |
| `hud.system_close()` | Closes the Ledger system window. |
| `hud.panels(spec: string)` | Plays a comic-panel cutscene: one shot per line, "x y z > tx ty tz | caption | sfx | seconds". Space or Enter skips. |
| `hud.boss(name: string, title: string)` | A boss bar (health and stagger) for the named entity; an empty name hides it. |
